Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound and entered the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2, southbound and
turning left, failed to yield and struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and
difficulty turning the upper body immediately after impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger position and
was also present at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent
witnesses gave consistent accounts of the signal phases and the point of impact. Scene photographs show intrusion
damage to the driver side door and quarter panel, which is consistent with the force of a broadside collision.
Responding officers observed no prior damage to either vehicle that would account for the injuries or the body
damage. Passenger and both drivers were identified as occupants of the vehicles at the time of the crash. Driver 1
was identified as a resident of the policyholder's household and is listed as a covered household member. Medical
transport was requested, and Driver 1 was transported to a local hospital for evaluation. Citaiton issued to Driver 2 for
failure to yield.
